event: 2025 ILCA 4 YOUTH EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIPS & OPEN EUROPEAN TROPHY
procedural_matters: FRA 225038 was represented by Raphael Olsthoorn.
The race committee was represented by Michal Jodlowski (Course Race Officer Area B).
On 25 June, FRA 225038 came back ashore earlier than the rest of the fleet around 15:00.
FRA 225038 delivered a scoring review at 15:38. The race committee answered the scoring review at 15:39.
FRA 225038 delivered a request for redress at 15:50.
facts: In race 11 (F5) of the ILCA 4 Boys gold fleet, the black flag was used as the preparatory signal.
Within the last minute before the starting signal of the race, FRA 225038 was inside the triangle formed by the ends of the line and the first mark, 2/3 down the starting line.
FRA 225038 was identified by the race committee on the starting vessel at the starting signal when she was already at least 2 boat lengths over the line.
The race committee displayed a general recall after the starting signal of the race.
The race committee displayed FRA 225038 sail number on the board before the next warning signal.
FRA 225038 was scored BFD in race 11 (F5).
conclusions: By scoring FRA 225038 who was identified inside the triangle formed by the ends of the starting line and the first mark during the last minute before the starting signal as BFD, the race committee did not do an improper action or omission. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
decision: Redress is not given to FRA 225038.
